note: Codex已审阅当天4项DeepSeek候选：两项Radio Nepal原文页面在复核时超时，因无法重新取得原文而不发布；总理会见印度大使一项已被外交部11月20日的国事访问原始公告覆盖，避免重复；塔托帕尼口岸条目仅为单一公共广播报道的外交请求，未获口岸运营主管机构或外交部的正式重开确认。其余候选是研讨会表态或救灾捐助，不构成可执行的ICT、采购或政策成果。未将模型候选作为正式证据。
noteEn: Codex reviewed the day's four DeepSeek candidates. Two Radio Nepal source pages timed out during re-fetch and were excluded because their original text could not be re-obtained; the Prime Minister–Indian Ambassador meeting is covered by Nepal MoFA's 20 November primary state-visit notice and was not duplicated; the Tatopani item is a diplomatic request in a single public-broadcaster report, without an official reopening confirmation from the operating authorities or MoFA. The remaining candidates are seminar remarks or disaster-relief donations without an actionable ICT, procurement or policy outcome. Model candidates were not used as formal evidence.
